proves.claim: pipelineRuntime finds the first event id inside the model's 26-hour floor by one-event probes and pages from there, so a board with more events than the window never reads from after=0 and hands the model only floor events.

view.pipeline.window-read.why: Reading the whole history of a 640k-event board sent 600 MB and left the Pipeline page on Reading forever.

proves.claim: pipelineRuntime keeps its own window per board, draws from a window that was complete once while new events arrive, and reads later events only after the last held id.

view.pipeline.window-live.why: A live board moves every second; re-reading the window or flickering back to Reading would make the page unusable.
